response: Ji bilkul, aapke 2 crore ke budget mein DHA Defence ke andar ye options hain: Lahore mein Lower Portion 1 Kanal (175 k) aur 2 Kanal House (190 k); Karachi mein 2 Kanal House 5 bed (100 k), 4 Marla House 3 bed (100 k) aur Upper Portion 1 Kanal (120 k). Agar koi specific property ya agent se baat karni ho to batayein, main connect kar dunga.
